title: Force magnitude expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) is correctly stated as F = mg sinθ + (mv²)/(2x).

title: Distance expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) is correctly stated as x' = v²/(2g sinθ).

title: Net force equation
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law correctly for the powered phase: F_net = F - mg sinθ = ma.

title: Acceleration from kinematics
description: Important: Uses the correct kinematic equation (v² = u² + 2as) to find the initial acceleration a = v²/(2x).

title: Post-force acceleration
description: Important: Identifies that after force removal, the acceleration down the incline is a' = g sinθ.

title: Post-force kinematics
description: Important: Applies the kinematic equation (v_f² = v_i² + 2a's) correctly for the deceleration phase to solve for x'.

title: Sign error in kinematics
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for acceleration in the kinematic equations for the deceleration phase (e.g., using +2a'x' instead of -2a'x').

title: Forgetting gravity component
description: Pitfall: Omits the mg sinθ component in the net force equation for the powered phase, using F = ma alone.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Verifies that the derived expressions for F and x' have the correct physical dimensions (Force and Length).
